en: A black-and-white photograph showing an urban street scene with mid-20th-century buildings. In the foreground, there is a construction site with workers assembling a building. The street is relatively wide and lined with trees and older houses. In the background, a hilly landscape is visible, with more residential blocks and a prominent cathedral or church with twin towers rising above the city. Some text is visible on a building along the street.
